name: Savory Broccoli-Cheddar Waffles with Ranch & Marinara Dipping Sauces (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved if you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Preheat waffle iron according to user's manual.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces.
Once the water is boiling, add broccoli and salt to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until very tender, 4-5 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to cool.
While the broccoli is cooking, place flour, baking powder, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dry ingredients and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 tsp baking powder
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place milk, eggs, and oil in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the wet ingredients.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup whole milk
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add wet ingredients to the bowl with the dry ingredients and stir until batter is just combined. Set aside.
Finely chop cooled broccoli. (If little ones want to help, transfer broccoli to another medium bowl and have them use a potato masher to crush the cooled broccoli.)
Add chopped (or crushed) broccoli to the bowl with the batter, along with cheese, and stir until incorporated.

Coat waffle iron with cooking spray. Working in batches, use a ⅓-cup measure (per waffle) to scoop batter into the preheated waffle iron. Close lid and cook until waffles are golden and crisp. Remove to a plate. (Alternatively, use a smaller or larger cup measure to fit your waffle iron's capacity.)
Divide waffles between plates and serve with ranch dressing and warm marinara sauce (optional) for dipping. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ranch dressing
½ cup marinara sauce
